entries.name: White-tailed deer
behaviour: buck rut with scrapes and rubs in autumn
white flag tail flares when alarmed
fawns hiding in leaf litter for the first weeks

voxel_model.pattern: white tail flag underside, white muzzle

entries.notes: The iconic deer of eastern woods; often browses around cabins and camps.

entries.name: Eastern gray squirrel
behaviour: buries thousands of acorns, forgets many
two litters in good years (spring and summer)
tail flags and kuks when a predator passes

voxel_model.pattern: white-edged bushy tail

entries.notes: The reason oak forests spread into new ground; bold around picnics.

entries.name: Eastern cottontail
behaviour: freezes flat, bolts in zigzags when caught out
several litters a year
forms shallow nests in grass

voxel_model.pattern: white cotton tail

entries.notes: The common rabbit of the eastern United States; short-lived, heavily preyed on, everywhere.

entries.name: Common raccoon
behaviour: manual dexterity: opens latches and bags
dabbles food in water before eating
dens in hollow trees and chimneys

voxel_model.pattern: black facial mask, ringed tail

entries.notes: The night bandit; curious, clever and completely unashamed around camps.

entries.name: Virginia opossum
behaviour: freezes into a coma-like fake death when threatened
mother carries young on her back
eats enormous numbers of ticks

voxel_model.pattern: long pink scaly prehensile tail, white face

entries.notes: North America's only marsupial; a valuable tick-vacuum around the homestead.

entries.name: Nine-banded armadillo
behaviour: jumps straight up when startled instead of fleeing
always identical quadruplet litters
hold breath up to 6 minutes to cross rivers

voxel_model.pattern: banded shell of nine movable scutes

entries.notes: Natural reservoir for leprosy and a famous cause of car crashes; expanding north into the South.

entries.name: Bobcat
behaviour: ambush hunter on trails and fence rows
stalks rabbits by frozen patience
ear tufts and a short black-tipped tail

voxel_model.pattern: spotted flanks, tufted ears, bobbed tail

entries.notes: North America's most common wild cat; thrives from swamps to suburbia.

entries.name: Wild turkey
behaviour: strutting gobbler display in spring
hens brood clutches of a dozen-plus eggs
roosts in trees at night

voxel_model.pattern: iridescent bronze barring, red-blue head

entries.notes: gestation_days is incubation time. Huge adaptable flock birds; the Thanksgiving icon.

entries.name: Barred owl
behaviour: classic 'who cooks for you' hooting in duet
hunts still water edges for frogs and fish
displaces and hybridises with spotted owls in the west

voxel_model.pattern: brown barring, dark eyes

entries.notes: gestation_days is incubation time. The common eastern owl of bottomland and swampy woods.

entries.name: American black bear
behaviour: enters a long winter den (near-hibernation)
breaks into cabins for bacon and sugar
cubs born in the den in late winter

voxel_model.pattern: black or cinnamon coat, straight facial profile, no shoulder hump

entries.notes: gestation includes delayed implantation. Dens up for weeks to months; raids bird feeders; eastern mountain and swamp icon.

entries.name: Wild boar
behaviour: sounder groups root up pasture like a plow
charges with tusks when cornered
wallows in mud to cool and coat itself

voxel_model.pattern: coarse bristle coat, razor tusks, striped piglets

entries.notes: Native from Europe to Asia; descended feral hogs in the southeastern United States and Australia wallow and wreck fields.

entries.name: American alligator
behaviour: builds 'alligator holes' that hold water for whole ecosystems in drought
bellows with low-frequency infrasonic rumbles
female guards the nest and carried hatchlings in her mouth

voxel_model.pattern: broad rounded snout, armoured scutes

entries.notes: gestation_days is egg incubation. Apex ambush predator of southeastern swamps and rivers; engineers gator holes during droughts.

entries.name: Cottonmouth
behaviour: stands ground and shows the white mouth when threatened instead of fleeing
often swims high in the water like a venomous cigar
live-bearing

voxel_model.pattern: dark crossbands, white inner mouth

entries.notes: The only venomous water snake of the southeast; short-tempered, thick-bodied moccasin of swamps.

entries.name: Alligator snapping turtle
behaviour: sits on the riverbed with a wiggly worm-like tongue luring fish
huge hooked beak can sever limbs
the largest freshwater turtle in the world

voxel_model.pattern: three ridged keels on the shell, hooked beak

entries.notes: gestation_days is egg incubation. A living dinosaur of southern rivers; the lure-and-ambush master.

entries.name: Koala
behaviour: sleeps 18-22 hours a day on a low-energy eucalyptus diet
one joey per year, carried in the pouch
eucalyptus toxins require picky species selection

voxel_model.pattern: fluffy ears, big leathery nose

entries.notes: Australia's teddy bear; the entire diet is eucalypt browse, which is why it cannot live elsewhere.

entries.name: Eastern grey kangaroo
behaviour: mobs grazing at dawn and dusk
male boxing matches balanced on tails
embryonic diapause: freezes a new embryo until the pouch joey leaves

voxel_model.pattern: muscular haunches, very long tail as tripod

entries.notes: The 64 km/h record belongs to a big eastern grey female; the classic kangaroo shape of the east.

entries.name: Short-beaked echidna
behaviour: lays one leathery egg into a temporary pouch
erects spines when balled into a prickly sphere
flicks a long sticky tongue into ant nests

voxel_model.pattern: spine-covered back, long slender beak

entries.notes: gestation_days is null: it lays eggs in a temporary pouch. The commonest icon of the monotremes after the platypus.

entries.name: Platypus
behaviour: hunts murky water with electrolocation on the bill
males have a venomous spur on each hind leg
builds a burrow nest in the riverbank

voxel_model.pattern: duck bill, otter body, flat beaver tail

entries.notes: gestation_days is null: it lays eggs (incubation ~10 days). So weird half the world thought early specimens were fakes.

entries.name: Laughing kookaburra
behaviour: famous cascading 'laugh' echoes at dawn and dusk
clan holds a territory and feeds a shared den
catches snakes with a strong dagger bill

voxel_model.pattern: white head with dark eye stripe, mottled brown wings

entries.notes: gestation_days is incubation time. The soundtrack of the Australian bush at dawn; a cooperative hunting kingfisher.

entries.name: Superb lyrebird
behaviour: unmatched mimic: chains of chainsaws, camera shutters, kookaburras
males build and display on a swept mound of scraped litter
rakes the forest floor - major engineer of leaf litter

voxel_model.pattern: lyre-shaped display tail of fine feathers

entries.notes: gestation_days is incubation time. The world's best mimic; a big pheasant-like forest floor engineer.

entries.name: Common (bare-nosed) wombat
behaviour: burrows extensively; the largest burrowing herbivore
rear armor shields it in a fight; buttresses bite hard
produces distinctive cube-shaped droppings

voxel_model.pattern: low slung, bear-like, squared rump

entries.notes: Can move over 40 km/h short bursts despite the round shape; great game animal for a stubborn prey quest.

entries.name: Sugar glider
behaviour: glides up to 50 m tree-to-tree on a patagium membrane
colony nests in a tree hollow shared for the season
sweet tooth plus insect tooth - chooses gum and bugs over fruit

voxel_model.pattern: membrane between limbs, dark dorsal stripe

entries.notes: Cute but requires big trees and nectar; a classic exotic pet and hard to keep humanely.

entries.name: Sika deer
entries.migrates: vertical: up to high mountain meadows in summer
behaviour: stag belling whistle in the autumn rut
white spots in summer flush
sacred semi-tame deer around shrines in Nara

voxel_model.pattern: white spots, dark dorsal stripe, branching antlers in males

entries.notes: The shika of Japanese temples and mountain moons; now naturalised and widespread in Europe.

entries.name: Japanese macaque
entries.migrates: seasonal: troops descend to warmer valley rivers and hot springs in winter
behaviour: bathes in hot springs in Jigokudani Park
troops led by dominant females; juvenile play strong
famous sweet-potato washing culture in some troops

voxel_model.pattern: red face and rump, thick grey-brown winter coat

entries.notes: The northernmost wild nonhuman primate; snow-monkey hot-spring baths are iconic in Honshu.

entries.name: Rhesus macaque
behaviour: troops raid crops and tourist sites
swims and eats crabs along rivers
classic lab and research primate

voxel_model.pattern: pink bare face, short tail, stocky build

entries.notes: The 'rhesus' behind the Rh blood-group story; found anywhere from Himalayan foothills to river mouths.

entries.name: Reeves's muntjac
behaviour: surprisingly loud dog-like bark echoes across valleys
male has tiny antlers and long upper canines
solitary, shy, mostly crepuscular

voxel_model.pattern: dark facial line from antler to snout

entries.notes: The barking deer of south China and Taiwan; a quiet legend of the forest understory.

entries.name: Raccoon dog (tanuki)
behaviour: the trickster tanuki of Japanese folklore
the only canid that effectively hibernates
pairs stay together for the year

voxel_model.pattern: raccoon-like mask but no ringed tail

entries.notes: Tanuki statues guard izakayas; an oddball spread into northern Europe in fur-farm escapes.

entries.name: Japanese giant salamander
behaviour: lives in clear mountain streams for over 50 years, over a century in captivity
sits motionless in a rock hollow, lunging at prey
fiercely territorial males in the breeding season

voxel_model.pattern: dorsoventrally flattened, wrinkled loose skin

entries.notes: gestation_days is null: it lays strings of eggs (incubation ~50 days). A living fossil in Honshu's clean rivers; endangered by river engineering.

entries.name: Chinese alligator
behaviour: lives in plowed rice paddies, ponds and ditches on the lower Yangtze
critically endangered; captive breeding program
broad osteoderms over head and a domed body

voxel_model.pattern: heavy osteoderms (bony back plates), broad snout

entries.notes: gestation_days is egg incubation. The world's most endangered crocodilian; almost a real-world ghost found in 1970s survey ponds.

entries.name: Giant panda
entries.migrates: vertical: bamboo forest altitudes through the year
behaviour: eats 12-38 kg of bamboo a day; false thumb from an enlarged wrist bone
females bear twins half the time but usually raise one
solitary except mothers with cubs

voxel_model.pattern: black ears, eye patches, limbs and shoulder band

entries.notes: Gestation uses delayed implantation (95-165 days). Flagship conservation species of the Sichuan/Shaanxi/Gansu Cwb highlands.

entries.name: Red panda
behaviour: arboreal and shy; spends the day curled in a forked tree with tail over face
barks loudly to defend territory
also has a false thumb wrist bone for gripping bamboo

voxel_model.pattern: ringed tail, white-masked face, rusty coat

entries.notes: 'Firefox'; more closely related to raccoons than to the giant panda. Key animal of the Himalaya-Yunnan subtropical highlands.

entries.name: Indian (greater one-horned) rhinoceros
behaviour: single horn on a huge armor-plated body; charges anything
loves swamp cool wallows and swimming
strongest in the Terai of Nepal and northern India

voxel_model.pattern: single horn, heavy armor-like skin folds

entries.notes: gestation is about 16 months. Bhagat of the Terai; conservation comeback from under 100 to over 4,000.

entries.name: Gaur
behaviour: tallest bovine in the world; bulls stand taller than a bison
high dorsal ridge of muscle; white 'stocking' lower legs
aggressive when cornered - one of Asia's most dangerous wild cattle

voxel_model.pattern: tall dorsal ridge, white-stockinged lower legs

entries.notes: The Indian bison; a true forest giant of India and mainland Southeast Asia.

entries.name: Asian elephant
entries.migrates: seasonal, follows food, water and crops
behaviour: matriarchal groups of females and calves
bulls in 'musth' are unpredictable and dangerous
raided crops and villages when forest is lost

voxel_model.pattern: smaller ears than African; single-domed head

entries.notes: gestation ~22 months. Smaller and rounder-eared than the African elephant; sacred in Hindu and Buddhist cultures.

entries.name: Maned wolf
behaviour: long legged 'guara' of the Cerrado - not a wolf nor a fox
its roar-bark travels kilometres
lobeira fruit is a huge part of the diet

voxel_model.pattern: long black mane, very long legs, white throat

entries.notes: An extraordinarily long-legged South American canid of the open subtropical Cerrado.

entries.name: South American coati
behaviour: female-and-young bands forage noisily through trees
males go solitary; scent-matches rivalling troops
mobile snout digs up larvae and roots like a trowel

voxel_model.pattern: long mobile snout, ringed lifted tail

entries.notes: A noisy troop animal of the South American subtropics; often bold at campsites and parks.

entries.name: Capybara
behaviour: world's largest rodent; semiaquatic grazing herds
dives like a furry submarine; webbed feet
tolerates birds, turtles and monkeys on its back

voxel_model.pattern: blunt square head, no visible tail, coarse fur

entries.notes: The grass-grazing tank of South American wetlands; low-stress, high-yield ranch animal in parts of the continent.

entries.name: Samango monkey
behaviour: South Africa's only true forest guenon; needs big mistbelt canopies
leaps through canopy with huge sweeping tail
seed disperser of the KZN mistbelt forests

voxel_model.pattern: dark agouti coat, white ear tufts, very long tail

entries.notes: A shy canopy monkey; forests of the KwaZulu-Natal mistbelt are its last stronghold in South Africa.

entries.name: Monarch butterfly
entries.migrates: multi-generational: north in spring, south to Mexican highlands in autumn
behaviour: larvae feed only on milkweed (Asclepias) leaves
sequester milkweed toxins - aposematic orange
the overwintering generation lives 7-8 months

voxel_model.pattern: orange wings with black veins and white-spotted black border

entries.notes: Iconic migrant; viceroy mimics it; crash driven by milkweed loss and illegal logging of overwintering groves.

entries.name: Luna moth
behaviour: adult lives about a week and has no mouthparts - does not feed
caterpillars browse hickory, sweetgum and walnut leaves
Hindwing tails spin in a spiral to confuse bat echolocation

voxel_model.pattern: lime-green wings with long tails and moon eyespots

entries.notes: Adults do not eat; a short, perfect, pale-green flight between the porch light and eternity.
